content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free hosting service that allows you to host websites directly from your GitHub repository. This service is particularly beneficial for digital creators who need a reliable and cost-effective way to sell ebooks, courses, or other downloadable products. By using GitHub Pages, you avoid the pitfalls of traditional e-commerce platforms that may impose high fees or restrict access based on location. This matters because it empowers creators to build their infrastructures without relying on third-party platforms that charge exorbitant fees, thus keeping more revenue from their sales.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind using GitHub Pages for your digital product store combines several technologies to create a seamless experience. At its core, GitHub Pages serves as the hosting platform, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can handle backend logic, such as processing orders and sending automated emails. Using NOWPayments facilitates cryptocurrency payment processing, allowing transactions to be confirmed on-chain with minimal fees. This architecture not only provides you with a fully operational store but also ensures that you maintain ownership of your data and your customer relationships.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment processors are restricted or unavailable. Whether you are selling ebooks, templates, or software, this approach gives you the tools to build a sustainable online business. Creators in countries like Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela can benefit immensely from this setup, as it provides full control over their sales process without the restrictions imposed by conventional platforms. It's about creating opportunities for those who have been sidelined by the mainstream digital commerce landscape.
GitHub Pages offers a free, reliable hosting solution for digital products.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful deployment of a digital product store using GitHub Pages integrates several key components. First, you need your GitHub repository where your site files will reside. Second, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage backend processes such as order management and email notifications. Third, storage solutions like Supabase or Google Sheets can keep track of orders and customer data. Finally, integrating NOWPayments allows you to accept cryptocurrencies directly, ensuring low transaction fees and immediate payment confirmations. Each component plays a crucial role in creating a seamless and efficient digital commerce experience.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with your GitHub Pages digital product store, first, create a GitHub account and set up a new repository for your project. Next, configure your repository to serve your site through GitHub Pages. After that, integrate Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend functionality. Then, set up your product listings and connect to NOWPayments for payment processing. Lastly, test the entire system to ensure that orders are processed correctly and files are delivered to customers. By following these steps, you can have your store up and running in no time.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using GitHub Pages combined with NOWPayments for payment processing. This approach allows you to host your store for free while accepting cryptocurrency payments with minimal fees. This architecture gives you the freedom to retain ownership of your sales and customer data.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, significantly reducing your transaction costs.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook without PayPal or Stripe?
You can sell an ebook using GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency payments. This setup allows you to avoid conventional payment platforms entirely.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?
Utilizing GitHub Pages and NOWPayments is one of the best ways to sell digital downloads without incurring high platform fees. GitHub Pages is free, and NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, by building your own store on GitHub Pages and integrating with NOWPayments, you can sell templates and fonts directly to your customers without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
What are the benefits of using cryptocurrencies for sales?

Using cryptocurrencies for sales allows you to avoid high transaction fees and provides immediate payment confirmations. It also opens up your store to a global audience without the limitations of traditional payment processors.
How can I ensure my digital product store is secure?
To ensure security, make sure to use HTTPS for your GitHub Pages site and use NOWPayments for secure payment processing. Regularly review your code and keep your dependencies updated.
Maintain full data ownership and independence from traditional payment platforms.
